gloss: to be full of anticipation; to be filled with expectation

definitions.gloss: to be full of anticipation; to be filled with expectation
definitions.explanation: To be brimming with eager anticipation or hopeful expectation about something that is going to happen.

examples.japanese: {期待|きたい}に{満|み}ちた⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{見|み}つめていた→見つめる：04571_mitsumeru⟧。
examples.english: She was gazing with eyes full of expectation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新入生|しんにゅうせい}→新入生：03073_shinnyuusei⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{期待|きたい}に{満|み}ちた⟦{表情|ひょうじょう}→表情：03585_hyoujou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{入学式|にゅうがくしき}→入学式：05495_nyuugakushiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{臨|のぞ}んだ→臨む：29038_nozomu⟧。
examples.english: The new students attended the entrance ceremony with expressions full of anticipation.

examples.japanese: {期待|きたい}に{満|み}ちた⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧、⟦{新製品|しんせいひん}→新製品：18629_shinseihin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: Amid an atmosphere brimming with anticipation, the announcement of the new product began.

notes:
Combines ⟦{期待|きたい}→期待：00238_kitai⟧ (expectation; anticipation) with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{満|み}ちる→満ちる：02428_michiru⟧ (to be filled with). Most commonly used in the past participle form {期待|きたい}に{満|み}ちた as a modifier before nouns like ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧ (eyes), ⟦{表情|ひょうじょう}→表情：03585_hyoujou⟧ (expression), or ⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧ (atmosphere).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {期待|きたい}に{満|み}ちた⟦{表情|ひょうじょう}→表情：03585_hyoujou⟧: an expression full of anticipation
- {期待|きたい}に{満|み}ちた⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧: eyes full of expectation
- {期待|きたい}に{満|み}ちた⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧: a voice brimming with expectation
- {期待|きたい}に{満|み}ちた⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧: an atmosphere full of anticipation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{希望|きぼう}→希望：00221_kibou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{満|み}ちる→満ちる：02428_michiru⟧: to be full of hope — focuses on hope rather than expectation
- ⟦{期待|きたい}→期待：00238_kitai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{胸|むね}→胸：00972_mune⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{膨|ふく}らませる→膨らむ：05342_fukuramu⟧: to swell with anticipation — more vivid, emphasizes the physical sensation of excitement
- ⟦わくわくする→ワクワクする：25801_wakuwakusuru⟧: to be excited; thrilled — more casual and emotive
